story_candidates.title: AMALIA and ANIA: what Portugal says about its own AI plans
story_candidates.angle: Two official sources on AI in Portugal. The government says its National AI Agenda (ANIA) has four areas and 32 initiatives and is in force from publication. INESC-ID says AMALIA, presented on 1 July 2026, is the first large language model built for European Portuguese, built on EuroLLM, with 80 researchers and 5.5 million euros of Recovery and Resilience funding. Neither page says AMALIA is one of ANIA's 32 initiatives, and both give aims, not results.
story_candidates.note: For journalist-portugal. Ready. Conditions: re-read both pages yourself; attribute everything to the institute and the government; use cases and impact are their expectations; do not link AMALIA to ANIA; no budget figure for ANIA (the page gives none); no company or lab beyond those named; short and plain (STYLE.md); categories Portugal and AI.
